detail.longDescription: ⚪️ Detecting Attack Traces in EDR Telemetry 🗨️ Penetration testers often have to deal with monitoring tools that must be bypassed before the security team raises the alarm. In this article, I’ll explain what the detection and response team can do to avoid missing an attack and to spot, in time, that someone is tampering with monitoring systems. 🔗 https:// hackmag.com/devops/detecting-e dr-bypass?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=repost_hackmag_to_socials # devops
